name: five-whys
description: Exhaustive Five Whys: asks why, or any combination of why, what, when, where and how, about one problem or a list, each up to five levels deep with five answers at every step (3,905 per tree at full depth), using parallel sub-agents in capped waves and a 1-5 model level, then assembles one JSON file plus an index and mechanical hygiene flags. Resumable and partial runs. Generation only; analysis is up to you.
